title: qopt: a verified Clifford+T circuit optimizer for T and CNOT counts
description: qopt reduces the T count and the CNOT count of Clifford+T circuits given as Toffoli networks. It provides a unitary mode (portfolio of evolved rewriting programs, phase folding, optional neural block resynthesis) and measurement-based modes that place Gidney logical-AND gates with measurement-based uncomputation automatically, by tracking every wire as a polynomial over GF(2). Every reported circuit is re-checked by an independent state-vector simulator (up to 22 qubits) or a sum-over-paths checker. Includes verified result circuits for 23 standard benchmarks in three cost models (unitary, strict measurement-based, clean ancillas), a comparison with nine quantum software tools, and reproduction scripts.
notes: Benchmark circuits in bench_qc/ are third-party data from the Feynman repository and are not covered by the Apache-2.0 license; see bench_qc/SOURCES.md.
